title: Use target support to reject impossible zero-raw finite-word synthesis
statement: With full-support source columns,every finite observation word has positive probability at every classical input. In a no-raw almost-surely finite protocol,an output forbidden at one input cannot occur with positive probability at another. An identity target therefore cannot avoid raw disclosure,unlike the strictly positive K construction.
